Guatemala has 22+ indigenous Mayan languages. In K'iche', Kaqchikel, or Mam, concepts of biological sex versus social gender may be conceptualized differently than in Spanish. If the respondent is monolingual in an indigenous language, the Spanish term 'sexo' might be interpreted through different cultural frameworks.

Many Guatemalans (particularly indigenous women or those in rural areas) may lack official ID documents, or their legal sex may not match their biological characteristics due to administrative errors or intersex conditions.
